title: HunterHR
tagline: AI-powered HR automation platform for screening, scheduling, and candidate communication.

overview.text:
HunterHR is an AI-powered, end-to-end recruitment automation platform designed to streamline hiring workflows across email, WhatsApp, resume parsing, candidate scoring, and interview scheduling.

Recruiters can create job openings with weighted criteria, automatically ingest applicant resumes via Gmail and WhatsApp scans, rank candidates using Ollama (LLaMA 3) and Qdrant vector embeddings, schedule interview slots synced with Google Calendar, and dispatch personalized offer or rejection letters using a rich-text template editor.

Originally prototyped with React, the system was completely re-architected into a modern Nuxt 4 full-stack platform with a high-throughput backend, responsive Nuxt UI v4 interface, and local AI inference.

userManual: Job Description Management - Create and configure job postings with title, salary band, qualifications, and locations - Set custom shortlisting weights (skills, experience, projects) and minimum passing scores - Auto or manual shortlisting mode with instant vector indexing into Qdrant Automated Multi-Channel Scanners - Gmail scanner fetches PDF resumes directly from candidate inbox emails - WhatsApp scanner connects via headless browser session to extract resumes from designated groups - Automated PDF extraction, deduplication, and persistent CDN storage on ImageKit AI Resume Scoring & Shortlisting - Local LLM inference (Ollama LLaMA 3 / Phi-3) classifies emails and validates job applications - Vector similarity matching (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings) against active job postings - Comprehensive data table with multi-criteria filtering, score ranges, and status tracking (shortlisted, selected, rejected) Interview Scheduling & Calendar Sync - Interactive event scheduler with configurable time slots, online/offline modes, and attendee capacity - Automated sync with Google Calendar API - Smart Auto-Assign distributes top-ranked candidates into available slots, or allows manual slot assignment Email Templates & Automated Dispatch - Rich text template builder powered by Tiptap v2 with variable placeholders (salary, candidate name, date, role) - Automated dispatch of interview invitations, acceptance letters, and polite rejections via Gmail API

items.caption: Jobs Page — Job Description Management & AI Scoring Weights
Scanners Page — WhatsApp Connection & Gmail Resume Scanner
Candidates Table — AI-Scored & Filterable Shortlisted Applicants
Interviews Page — Event Scheduler, Google Calendar Sync & Slot Assignment
Email Templates — Drag-and-Drop & Rich Text Template Editor

devNotes: Tech Stack Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Nuxt UI v4, TailwindCSS v4, TypeScript, Node.js (Nitro / H3), PostgreSQL 15, Qdrant Vector DB, Redis, Ollama (LLaMA 3 / Phi-3), Docker, Google Workspace APIs (Gmail & Calendar), WhatsApp-web.js (Puppeteer), Tiptap Editor, ImageKit Evolution & Migration Originally developed and prototyped as a React + Node.js client-server application, HunterHR was fully redesigned and re-engineered into an all-in-one full-stack Nuxt 4 (Vue 3) application. The rewrite leveraged Nuxt server routes (Nitro/H3), reactive Nuxt UI components, and TailwindCSS v4 for unified developer ergonomics, faster SSR rendering, and robust state management. AI Pipeline & Vector Search Resumes parsed from PDF streams are embedded using BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 into Qdrant for semantic cosine-similarity matching against active job requirements. Ollama runs local LLaMA 3 / Phi-3 models to classify application emails and validate candidate suitability with zero external data leakage. Automation & Integration Features background ingestion pipelines via WhatsApp-web.js (headless Puppeteer) and Gmail API, Google Calendar synchronization for two-way interview scheduling, and ImageKit CDN for persistent asset storage.

title: OldMonkey

overview.text: My journey of touch typing started back in high school. I spent months on keybr.com to unlearn bad habits and learn touch typing from scratch, then migrated to monkeytype.com to push my raw speed. Naturally, I wanted to build a tribute to the community that made me faster. OldMonkey is a real-time multiplayer typing game where players compete head-to-head, chasing live opponent cursors through paragraphs while WPM and accuracy update every keystroke.

userManual: Multiplayer & Bot Mode Challenge friends to a live match or go up against an adaptive bot that targets ~8 WPM above your personal best — the only way to beat it is to beat yourself. Social Matchmaking Find rivals by username or filter opponents by WPM speed brackets (e.g., 60–70 WPM) to get evenly matched races. Live Opponent Cursor Watch your opponent's cursor move through the paragraph in real-time — chase them down or pull ahead, character by character. Competitive Rating System Start at 500 rating with a transparent +5/−5 system. Every race counts toward your rank. Chat & Invites Message rivals, send game invites, and share matches directly from the platform. Game History Track every race — review past WPM, accuracy, and results to measure your improvement over time. Secure Accounts Sign up with email (OTP verified) or Google.

items.caption: User profile, game history, room creation, find players

devNotes: Architecture Event-driven real-time system using WebSockets for character-by-character synchronization and long polling for chats. Stack Python, FastAPI, WebSockets, Redis, MongoDB, JWT, Google OIDC, Argon2 Real-Time Sync Redis manages all live game state and timer synchronization, keeping latency sub-second across concurrent matches. Ghost Cursors stream opponent position updates to all connected clients via WebSocket. Monkey Engine A custom adaptive bot built in Python that reads the player's top speed and targets roughly 8 WPM higher — scaling dynamically so the challenge never plateaus. Auth Full authentication pipeline with JWT sessions, Google OIDC login, OTP email verification, and Argon2 password hashing.

title: Testron
tagline: An evaluation platform with real-time testing, coding evaluation, and classroom management.

overview.text: An end-to-end online examination platform designed for coaching institutes, teachers, and students to conduct secure and scalable assessments. The platform supports MCQ, numerical, and coding-based examinations with advanced evaluation logic inspired by competitive exams like JEE and NTA-based assessments. The system includes separate teacher and student portals, classroom management, scheduled and deadline-based tests, automatic evaluation, topic-wise analytics, and isolated Docker sandboxes for executing programming questions securely.

userManual: Authentication & Access 1. Register using email OTP verification 2. Login using Google OAuth (OIDC) 3. Access separate Teacher and Student dashboards 4. Join classrooms using invite codes or links Teacher Features 1. Create and manage classrooms/groups 2. Approve or reject student join requests 3. Create tests with custom timers and marking schemes 4. Configure scheduled tests or deadline-based attempts 5. Add MCQ, numerical, and coding questions 6. Upload question images and test assets 7. View student submissions and analytics 8. Track topic-wise performance insights Student Features 1. Join classrooms using group codes 2. Attempt tests in a real-time exam interface 3. Navigate between questions during the exam 4. Solve coding problems with instant execution feedback 5. Receive automatic score calculation after submission 6. View previous test history and performance reports Evaluation Rules - Correct answers receive full marks - Wrong answers apply negative marking - Unattempted questions receive zero marks - MCQs support partial marking logic - Coding questions are validated using visible and hidden test cases Security & Proctoring - Auto-submit on tab switching - Isolated Docker containers for code execution - Secure backend validation for all submissions
devNotes: Architecture The platform follows a modular Django app-based architecture separating authentication, classroom management, testing, evaluation, analytics, and sandbox execution into independent domains. Backend Stack - Django - PostgreSQL - Redis - Docker - Docker Compose Authentication Implemented email OTP authentication using Redis for temporary OTP storage along with Google OIDC login using OAuth 2.0. Realtime & Timer Logic Redis was used for managing volatile exam state such as countdown timers, OTP expiry, and rapid-fire question timing. Code Execution Sandbox Coding questions are executed inside isolated Docker containers to securely run untrusted user code with controlled resources and hidden test cases. Evaluation Engine Built a custom scoring engine supporting: - Negative marking - Partial marking for MCQs - Numerical answer validation - Hidden test case evaluation - Auto-generated result computation.

title: 925buddy
tagline: An AI-driven job search engine that automates job discovery, matching, and monitoring.

overview.text:
As a fresher actively applying for jobs myself, I wanted to build something that solves the “tab-fatigue” most job-seekers face.

Job hunting today feels like a full-time unpaid job in itself.
Two hours on LinkedIn and Indeed… and Wellfound still left.
Eyes burning. Tabs everywhere.

Most of us spend hours reading roles we don’t even qualify for: scrolling past Laravel jobs when our stack is Django, manually tracking what we applied to, and repeating the same searches every single day.

So I built 925buddy: a backend-first, AI-driven job search engine that scrapes, understands, matches, and monitors jobs automatically, so users stop searching and start receiving.

userManual: From a user's perspective With 925buddy, you can: - Upload your resume (PDF) - Scrape jobs across portals (Indeed, Naukri) - View all jobs in one place with pagination & filters - Ask a chatbot questions like: - “Which jobs fit me best?” - “What skills am I missing for backend roles?” - Schedule daily/weekly background scraping - Receive email notifications when strong matches appear - Everything is private, isolated per user, and can work even if you’re offline.

items.caption: Get jobs from multiple portals like Naukri, Indeed etc. in a centralized dashbaord.
Talk with the chatbot to get perfect jobs that match your skills, to get hot skills in the market or anything you want to know related to jobs and your skills.

devNotes: From the developer's perspective This system is built as a RAG + async backend pipeline: 🔹 Data ingestion ◽ Selenium + BeautifulSoup scrape full job descriptions ◽ Jobs are normalized and stored in MongoDB ◽ Each job is tagged to a specific user (multi-tenant design) 🔹 Resume intelligence ◽ PDF resumes are uploaded and stored securely in ImageKit ◽ Text extracted via PyMuPDF ◽ Chunked using LangChain RecursiveTextSplitter ◽ Embedded with Sentence Transformers 🔹 Vector search & RAG ◽ Job + resume embeddings stored in ChromaDB ◽ On every query: - Relevant resume + job chunks retrieved via cosine similarity - Context passed to Groq LLM - Strict RAG guardrails prevent hallucination if no data exists 🔹 Proactive search agent ◽ Celery + Redis (RedBeat) handle scheduled scraping ◽ Background workers: - Scrape jobs - Embed new data - Compute similarity scores - Trigger email alerts if score exceeds threshold 🔹 Backend & infra ◽ FastAPI (JWT auth, protected routes) ◽ MongoDB (users, jobs, metadata) ◽ ChromaDB (vector store) ◽ Docker + Docker Compose (Redis, workers) ◽ Fully async, non-blocking architecture Tech Stack FastAPI, Python, MongoDB, ChromaDB, Celery, Redis, Docker, Groq LLM, Sentence Transformers, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, PyMuPDF, LangChain, ImageKit

title: Jimi
tagline: A full-featured musical instrument marketplace and social platform for musicians and guitar enthusiasts.

overview.text: Jimi is a modern guitar and musical instrument marketplace platform that combines e-commerce, community interaction, and admin-driven business management into a single ecosystem. The platform allows users to browse and purchase musical instruments, check delivery availability using pin codes and shop radius validation, track orders, and interact with a moderated social feed built for musicians. Admins can manage inventory, products, orders, discounts, and community moderation through a dedicated dashboard, while users get a seamless shopping and community experience tailored for music enthusiasts.

userManual: Marketplace Features - Browse guitars and musical instruments - Search and filter products - Add products to cart and place orders - Secure online payments - Track order history and delivery status - Check delivery availability using pin code support Community Features - Create and share posts - Like, comment, and save posts - Explore a musician-focused social feed - Build profiles and interact with other users - Admin-moderated community system Admin Features - Add and manage products - Track inventory and orders - Manage discounts and offers - Moderate community posts - Access analytics and dashboard tools User Experience - Unified shopping and social platform - Clean marketplace workflow - Musician-focused ecosystem - Mobile-friendly browsing experience
devNotes: Built With FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLAlchemy, Docker, Docker Compose, NGINX, Celery, Razorpay, ImageKit Architecture The platform was designed as a modular backend system combining e-commerce, order management, payments, inventory handling, and a social media layer for musicians. PostgreSQL was used for transactional systems like users and orders, while MongoDB handled product catalogs and social content. Redis and Celery powered background workflows such as notifications, asynchronous processing, and session handling. The application was containerized using Docker and structured for scalable deployment and service orchestration.

title: Bluff Game
tagline: A real-time multiplayer bluff card game with live chat and peer-to-peer video communication.

overview.text: Bluff Game is a real-time multiplayer implementation of the classic Bluff (Cheat) card game designed for interactive online gameplay. The platform allows players to create and join game rooms, play live matches with synchronized turns and card actions, communicate through in-room chat, and connect using built-in video and voice calling. The experience combines competitive gameplay with social interaction, creating a lightweight virtual game room where players can bluff, challenge, react, and communicate in real time.

userManual: Gameplay Features - Create or join multiplayer game rooms - Play live Bluff card matches with 2–4 players - Perform card claims and challenge opponent moves - View automated card reveals and pile handling - Track active turns and player actions in real time Communication Features - In-room live chat system - Peer-to-peer video calling - Voice communication during gameplay - Camera and microphone controls - Join and leave calls dynamically Room Experience - Persistent multiplayer rooms - Real-time game synchronization - Interactive multiplayer environment - Fast-paced social gameplay experience

items.caption: Real-time bluff gameplay and card actions

devNotes: Built With FastAPI, Python, WebSockets, WebRTC, MongoDB, JWT Authentication, Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 Architecture The platform uses WebSockets for synchronized multiplayer gameplay and room-based real-time communication. WebRTC was integrated for peer-to-peer video and voice calling, while MongoDB handled room state and user data persistence. The application was designed as a multi-page real-time system with asynchronous backend handling for concurrent player actions and low-latency interaction.

title: Gmail Organizer
tagline: An AI-powered Gmail automation system for inbox organization, classification, and smart email workflows.

overview.text:
Gmail Organizer is an AI-driven inbox management platform designed to automate how users handle and organize their emails.

The system connects directly to Gmail accounts and uses intelligent agent workflows to scan inboxes, classify emails, generate summaries, draft responses, and perform automated cleanup actions such as archiving or deleting low-value messages.

Built with a modular agent architecture, the platform focuses on reducing inbox overload while providing users with a cleaner, more organized email experience.

userManual: Inbox Automation - Connect your Gmail account securely - Scan and analyze inbox activity - Automatically classify emails into categories - Identify important emails, OTPs, spam, and low-priority messages - Generate structured inbox summaries AI Assistance - Draft replies for urgent emails - Organize inbox content intelligently - Perform automated cleanup actions - Archive or delete unwanted emails User Experience - Centralized inbox organization - Reduced manual email management - Faster prioritization of important communication - Modular workflow designed for future automation upgrades
devNotes: Built With FastAPI, Python, CrewAI, Google OAuth 2.0, Gmail API Architecture The system was designed using an agent-based workflow architecture separating email analysis and execution into independent components. CrewAI was used for orchestrating the automation pipeline, while Gmail API integration enabled inbox access, classification, and automated actions. The backend was built as an async-friendly modular API system with extensibility for future real-time streaming and background task processing.

title: Tubedown
tagline: A lightweight media downloader for YouTube videos, playlists, audio, and subtitles.

overview.text: A simple cross-platform downloader designed to make saving YouTube content fast and accessible. The application allows users to download single videos, entire playlists, audio as MP3, and subtitles in SRT format through a clean and minimal interface. I initially built the project as a lightweight backend utility using Python and FastAPI to experiment with media streaming and download automation. Later, the project was migrated to a Flutter mobile application to provide a smoother mobile experience and better usability.

userManual: Getting Started 1. Paste a YouTube video or playlist link 2. Select the download type 3. Start the download 4. Access the downloaded files locally Supported Features - Download single videos - Download complete playlists - Extract audio as MP3 - Download playlists as MP3 - Download subtitles in SRT format - Batch playlist downloads User Experience - Minimal and easy-to-use interface - Quick media downloads - Mobile-friendly experience - Simple one-click workflow - Organized downloaded files
devNotes: Built With - Python - FastAPI - pytubefix - ffmpeg - Flutter - Dart Backend Functionality The backend handled video streaming, playlist processing, MP3 extraction, subtitle generation, and ZIP-based batch downloads using the pytubefix library. Mobile Application The project was later migrated to Flutter by my friend Ratnadeep to provide a faster and more polished mobile experience with improved download handling and file management.

title: OLX CGEC
tagline: A college marketplace platform for buying, selling, and managing student listings securely.

overview.text:
OLX CGEC is a college-focused marketplace platform built to simplify buying and selling within the campus community.

The platform allows students to create listings, upload product images, manage their posts, and securely process payments through an integrated checkout flow.
